name: Alchemist
tagline: Experiments its way to a method for undocumented problems
description: For the class of problem where no documentation exists and nobody has written the answer down anywhere. It probes your codebase, a website, an API or a tool on your own machine, tries an approach, watches what breaks, and keeps going until it has something that genuinely works.
